title: PageLedger Cost Report
description: Page-denominated cost rollup for a run. Schema version 0.1.

pricing.description: User-configured pricing dict. Null or empty when no rates are set.

usage.description: Rolled-up usage across all pages. May be null for fields where no adapter reported values.

extraction_seconds.description: Wall-clock extraction time measured by the runner across all pages. Distinct from adapter-reported compute_seconds.

cost_usd.description: Estimated total cost in USD. Null when cost is unknown.

cost_known.description: True if cost_usd is meaningful (at least one page had a known cost). False when pricing is absent and no adapter reported cost.

cost_basis.description: Where the dollar figure came from: real adapter-reported spend, the user's configured accounting rate, both, or nowhere (free/local engine with no pricing).

budget.description: Per-unit budget status. Present when any budget cap is configured.
